Program_Manager.label: Program Manager
Program_Manager.description: The uCIFI Program Manager describes the scheduling capabilities of the device, referring to Program Schedulers, Program Functions, Calendar Rules and Filters.

Max_number_of_Program_Schedulers.label: Max number of Program Schedulers
Max_number_of_Program_Schedulers.description:
Maximum number of program schedulers supported by the device.
Can be eventually adjusted in order to reserve more or less memory.

Current_number_of_Program_Schedulers.label: Current number of Program Schedulers
Current_number_of_Program_Schedulers.description: Number of program schedulers currently allocated.

Current_number_of_Program_Functions.label: Current number of Program Functions
Current_number_of_Program_Functions.description: Number of program functions currently allocated.

Max_number_of_Dates_in_Calendar.label: Max number of Dates in Calendar
Max_number_of_Dates_in_Calendar.description:

Max_Flash_Memory_Allocated.label: Max Flash Memory Allocated
Max_Flash_Memory_Allocated.description:

Error_Conditions.label: Error Conditions
Error_Conditions.description:
Bitmap
Bit 0: No valid program 
Bit 1: Missing configuration objects 
Bit 2: Missing configuration resources 
Bit 3: Invalid inputs
Bit 4: Invalid outputs
Bit 5: Invalid function format
Bit 6: Out of storage memory
Bit 7: Out of runtime memory
Bit 8..31: reserved for future use

Supported_Capabilities.label: Supported Capabilities
Supported_Capabilities.description:
Bitmap
Bit 0: Astronomical Events
Bit 1: Single sensor Inputs
Bit 2: Multi Sensor Inputs
Bit 3: Input Filters
Bit 4: Output Filters
Bit 5: Calendar
Bit 6: Compound Operations
Bit 7: Second granularity (for fixed time expressions)
Bit 8: Astronomical Midnight
Bit 9: Off when inactive

Max_Dynamic_Memory_Allocated.label: Max Dynamic Memory Allocated
Max_Dynamic_Memory_Allocated.description:
Max RAM memory (in bytes) to be allocated.
Can be eventually adjusted in order to reserve more or less memory

Clear_errors.label: Clear errors
Clear_errors.description:
When executed, clears temporary error conditions.
To be noted that some of the errors may require to change the content of other objects to be completely cleared.

Reset_schedule_objects.label: Reset schedule objects
Reset_schedule_objects.description: When executed, trigger a complete wipe of schedules already commissioned
